title: deploy README documents BBOX_ALLOW_NONLOOPBACK_BIND which no code reads
wanted_capability: deploy/docker/README.md:40 instructs setting BBOX_ALLOW_NONLOOPBACK_BIND for Kubernetes exposure, but the variable appears nowhere in code (whole-tree grep); BBOX_BIND=0.0.0.0 needs no grant and is_loopback_bind gates only the webhook no-signature escape. Either implement the guard the README implies or delete the line so operators do not treat an inert variable as a safety gate.
fallback_used: Downstream deployment treats the variable as inert and relies on network posture for bind exposure decisions.
resolution_note: deploy/docker/README.md no longer presents BBOX_ALLOW_NONLOOPBACK_BIND as a gate: it states BBOX_BIND alone decides exposure, the daemon's loopback check gates only the unsigned-webhook escape, network posture is the control, and names fleetd's real BLACKBOX_FLEETD_ALLOW_NONLOOPBACK_TCP grant. Implementing a daemon-side grant was considered and deferred: it would refuse startup on any host binding a tailnet address without the new variable.
